description: Change what the page does: whether new supporters go up without approval, whether people may give without a name, whether the supporter count and total show, the three suggested amounts and their labels, the headline on the pay card, the note supporters see after paying, when stream alerts fire, and whether voice messages are allowed (Premium). Passing amounts replaces all three. A label or headline that fails the word filter is blanked. Affects future supports only. Writes to the creator's own Kulhad account only.

allowAnonymous.description: Let people give without leaving a name.

amountStyle.description: Which set of suggested amounts the page offers.

amounts.description: The three suggested amounts and what each is for.

autoPublish.description: Put a supporter on the page as soon as they mark a payment as sent, without waiting for approval.

cardHeadline.description: The line above the name on share cards.

counterQrEnabled.description: Offer the printable counter QR, which carries no amount and no message.

showSupporterCount.description: Show how many people have given.

streamAlertOn.description: When the stream alert overlay fires. "approved" waits until you have looked at a support, which is how every other surface behaves. "claimed" fires as soon as someone marks a payment as sent, which is faster but puts a message nobody has read yet on the stream. Only change this to "claimed" if the creator has said they want that.

thankYouNote.description: Shown to a supporter after they pay.

voiceBlessingsEnabled.description: Let supporters record a short voice message. Premium.

name: update_page_behaviour
title: Change how my page behaves
